name: Norway

train.sum: Oslo S (Oslo Central) is the hub for all long-distance trains: Vy to Bergen, Skien and Gothenburg, SJ Norge to Trondheim, Lillehammer and Stockholm, Go-Ahead Nordic to Kristiansand and Stavanger, and Snälltåget to Gothenburg and Malmö. The Flytoget airport train and local trains also use Oslo S and Nationaltheatret.
train.sched: Long-distance trains run from early morning to evening, with night trains to Bergen, Trondheim and Stavanger. A new timetable starts on 13 December 2026. Check vy.no or entur.no for exact times.
tickets: Long-distance fares work like airline fares: the cheapest tickets sell out first, so book early on vy.no, sj.no or entur.no
Children under 6 travel free. Children 6 to 17, students and seniors get discounts
Night trains offer a seat, a comfort seat or a sleeping compartment. Reserve in advance
Interrail and Eurail passes are accepted on most trains. Reservations are required on long-distance services
Flåm Railway (Myrdal to Flåm, on the Bergen Line): book through Vy or Entur in advance
Ruter tickets are valid on Vy trains inside Oslo and Akershus, including the airport
train.tip: Entur (entur.no and the Entur app) shows every Norwegian operator in one place with no booking fee. Compare Vy, SJ Norge and Go-Ahead Nordic there.
buy: Vy app or vy.no for Vy trains
SJ Norge: sj.no, or Entur for Trondheim and Lillehammer
Go-Ahead Nordic and Snälltåget: their own websites, or Entur
Entur app or entur.no for all Norwegian trains
Vy sales points at Oslo S
Stockholm trains: SJ app or sj.se

destinations.note: Flytoget takes about 19 min, Vy regional trains about 23 min
On the Dovre Line towards Trondheim
About 6 direct trains a day on the Sørland Line
Bergen Line over the Hardangervidda plateau, with a night train. Change at Myrdal for the Flåm Railway
Dovre Line, with several day trains and one night train each way
Day trains via Kristiansand. The night train takes about 9 h 15 min
Vy runs about every 2 hours. For Copenhagen change at Gothenburg, about 8 h 15 min in total
Several trains a day. Reservations are required
Daily day train via Gothenburg since 15 June 2026

tram.sum: Ruter runs the T-bane (metro), trams, buses and boats in Oslo and Akershus on one ticket system. Six tram lines (12, 13, 15, 17, 18 and 19) serve the centre, and the T-bane has five lines through a shared city tunnel.
tram.sched: Check the Ruter app for exact times. The metro usually does not run at night. The metro is largely closed on 19 to 22 November 2026 for signal testing, with replacement buses and tram 19x.
tickets: Single ticket: 46 NOK adult, 23 NOK senior (67 and over), 19 NOK child (6 to 17). Valid 60 minutes in one zone, plus 30 minutes for each extra zone
30-day ticket, Zone 1 (Oslo): 495 NOK adult, 281 NOK senior, 199 NOK child, 293 NOK student
24-hour and 7-day tickets: see the Ruter app for current prices. A 7-day ticket is valid for 7 days from activation
Oslo Pass (24, 48 or 72 hours): includes public transport in Oslo and Akershus, the airport train and many museums. Prices on visitoslo.com
Children under 6 travel free. On weekends and public holidays an adult can bring up to four children under 18 free
Fine without a valid ticket: 1,200 NOK on the spot, 1,470 NOK on invoice. Under 18: 1,200 NOK
tram.tip: Activate your ticket on the reader every time you board a bus, tram, boat or metro. An unactivated ticket is treated as no ticket, and not knowing is not an excuse.
buy: Ruter app (card or Vipps), the easiest way
Physical travel card, 50 NOK, from Narvesen, 7-Eleven and Mix kiosks
Ruter customer centre at Jernbanetorget 1
Ruter online store (for a travel card)
Also sold in the Vy, Entur and Brakar apps
Not possible on trams or the metro. Buy before you board

bus.sum: Ruter city buses cover Oslo and Akershus on the same fares as the metro and tram. Line numbers 20 to 87 serve Oslo, with express lines marked E. Boats in the fjord (lines B1 and B2 to the islands, B10 to Nesodden) accept the same ticket.
bus.sched: Buses run all day. Night buses (lines with N, such as 1N, 2N, 3N) run on Friday and Saturday nights from the centre, mostly from about 01:00.
tickets: Same fares as the metro: 46 NOK adult single, 23 NOK senior, 19 NOK child
On board buses and boats a single ticket costs 20 NOK more for adults and 10 NOK more for children and seniors
Night buses use a normal Ruter ticket
Island ferries B1 and B2 use a normal Ruter ticket and run mainly in summer
Long distance: Vy and other express buses leave from Oslo Bus Terminal
bus.tip: Buy in the Ruter app before you board. The driver sells single tickets for cash only, and notes over 200 NOK are not accepted.
buy: Ruter app before you board
Travel card loaded with a ticket, activated on the reader
Driver: single ticket only, cash only, notes over 200 NOK not accepted, costs more
Boats: single tickets can be bought on board in cash
Kiosks and the Jernbanetorget customer centre

airport.sum: Oslo Airport (OSL) is at Gardermoen, about 50 km north of the city. The Flytoget Airport Express reaches Oslo S in about 19 minutes, and Vy regional trains take about 23 minutes.
airport.sched: Flytoget runs about 6 times an hour to Oslo S (about every 10 minutes in the day). Vy regional trains run about 3 times an hour. Flybussen coaches take 40 to 60 minutes to the centre.
tickets: Flytoget to Oslo S: 276 NOK adult, 138 NOK for youth 16 to 20, students and seniors over 67. Children under 16 travel free with an adult
Flytoget return ticket: valid for 90 days on any departure
Vy regional train: about half the price of Flytoget. Price shown on vy.no and in the Vy app
Ruter tickets are valid on Vy trains to the airport if they cover zone 4V. Check the zones in the Ruter app
Flybussen: price on flybussen.no, cheaper when bought in advance
Taxi: order at the machines outside arrivals, which show the fare before you ride
airport.tip: Vy regional trains take only 3 to 4 minutes longer than Flytoget and cost much less. Flytoget does not accept Ruter tickets.
buy: Flytoget: app, website, ticket machines, or tap a bank card at the station reader
Vy: app or vy.no
Ruter app (airport zone ticket)
Flybussen: flybussen.no or machines at the airport; card or cash on the bus
Taxi: order at the machines outside arrivals

metro.note: The T-bane has five lines that share a tunnel through the centre. On 19 to 22 November 2026 almost the whole metro is closed day and night for signal testing. More closures are planned in 2027 on school and public holidays.
lines: Majorstuen, Nationaltheatret, Stortinget, Jernbanetorget, Grønland and Tøyen are on the shared city tunnel

tips: Activate your ticket on a reader every time you board. The fine without a valid ticket is 1,200 NOK on the spot or 1,470 NOK by invoice.
Almost the whole T-bane is closed from 19 to 22 November 2026. Use the replacement buses and tram 19x, and check the Ruter app.
Compare Vy and Flytoget for the airport. Vy is much cheaper and only a few minutes slower.
On trams and the metro you cannot buy a ticket on board. Buses and boats sell single tickets for cash only, at a higher price.
